notes: 保留原游戏立绘；AI 辅助补充局部眼部与嘴型。
自然眨眼为补画帧；正面微笑沿用原画的闭眼笑。
正面说话嘴型取自原画差分，侧身说话嘴型使用 AI 局部补画。
当前为无声口型演示，并非语音同步或 Live2D 模型。
七套近景头顶已补全；画布上方增加 64 像素，原有身体像素不变，脸部与嘴部坐标同步下移。原图另存，不打包进应用。

provenance.prompts: Prompts retained in the reviewed preview source archive; not required at runtime.
provenance.method: Only registered eye and mouth regions are composited. Original alpha is retained. Sheet backgrounds are discarded.

hairRepair.tool: built-in image_gen; Swift/ImageIO alignment and alpha extraction
hairRepair.method: AI crown pixels are confined to 64 newly added rows. The original 606 RGBA rows are retained unchanged at offset (0,64). Existing face frames are reused.
